mapper.select: SELECT MENU_CODE, MENU_NM, REL_CODE, MENU_URL, ICON_NM, SORT_NO, AUTH_PATTERN, NEW_WIN_YN FROM TB_EEP_MENU WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_NO, MENU_CODE
SELECT R.ROLE_CD, RM.MENU_CODE FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_MENU_R RM ON RM.ROLE_SQ = R.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}

SELECT MENU_CODE, MENU_NM, REL_CODE, MENU_URL, ICON_NM, SORT_NO, USE_YN, AUTH_PATTERN, NEW_WIN_YN FROM TB_EEP_MENU WHERE REL_CODE IS NULL OR REL_CODE IN (SELECT MENU_CODE FROM TB_EEP_MENU) ORDER BY SORT_NO, MENU_CODE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_MENU WHERE REL_CODE = #{menuCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_MENU (MENU_CODE, MENU_NM, REL_CODE, MENU_DEPTH, MENU_URL, ICON_NM, SORT_NO, USE_YN, AUTH_PATTERN, NEW_WIN_YN, FRST_REGISTER, FRST_REG_DT, LAST_UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{MENU_CODE}, #{MENU_NM}, #{REL_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MENU_DEPTH}, #{MENU_URL,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ICON_NM,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{SORT_NO}, #{USE_YN}, #{AUTH_PATTERN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{NEW_WIN_YN}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE MENU_NM = VALUES(MENU_NM), REL_CODE = VALUES(REL_CODE), MENU_DEPTH = VALUES(MENU_DEPTH), MENU_URL = VALUES(MENU_URL), ICON_NM = VALUES(ICON_NM), SORT_NO = VALUES(SORT_NO), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), AUTH_PATTERN = VALUES(AUTH_PATTERN), NEW_WIN_YN = VALUES(NEW_WIN_YN), LAST_UPDT_DT = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_MENU SET REL_CODE = #{REL_CODE,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, MENU_DEPTH = #{MENU_DEPTH}, SORT_NO = #{SORT_NO}, LAST_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE MENU_CODE = #{MENU_CODE}
mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_SQ, ROLE_CD, ROLE_NM, ROLE_DESC, SYSTEM_YN FROM TB_EEP_ROLE_M ORDER BY SORT_NO, ROLE_SQ
SELECT U.ROLE_SQ, U.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_EMAIL, DATE_FORMAT(U.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DT FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E ON E.EMPLY_ID = U.EMPLY_ID ORDER BY E.EMPLY_NM

SELECT EMPLY_ID, MAX(EMPLY_NM) AS EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD = '2' AND IFNULL(DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND IFNULL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND EMPLY_ID IS NOT NULL AND EMPLY_ID <> '' GROUP BY EMPLY_ID ORDER BY EMPLY_NM
SELECT ROLE_SQ, ROLE_CD, ROLE_NM, SYSTEM_YN FROM TB_EEP_ROLE_M WHERE ROLE_SQ = #{roleSq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_ROLE_M (ROLE_CD, ROLE_NM, ROLE_DESC, SORT_NO) SELECT #{ROLE_CD}, #{ROLE_NM}, #{ROLE_DESC,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IFNULL(MAX(SORT_NO), 0) + 1 FROM TB_EEP_ROLE_M
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_ROLE_M SET ROLE_NM = #{ROLE_NM}, ROLE_DESC = #{ROLE_DESC,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ROLE_SQ = #{ROLE_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_ROLE_MENU_R (ROLE_SQ, MENU_CODE) SELECT #{ROLE_SQ}, MENU_CODE FROM TB_EEP_MENU WHERE MENU_URL IS NOT NULL AND MENU_CODE IN #{code}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId} AND EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD = '2' AND IFNULL(DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND IFNULL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R (EMPLY_ID, ROLE_SQ, REG_EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{EMPLY_ID}, #{ROLE_SQ}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND ROLE_SQ = #{ROLE_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R WHERE ROLE_SQ = #{roleSq}
